operators.name: Unpredictable Recombination
operators.notes: Random merge of pooled prefixes/suffixes. Physics in this file + empirical dataset.

operators.name: Predictable Recombination
operators.notes: Player picks mods; UI shows success %. Failure destroys both. Without a displayed/empirical chance → unranked (do not invent).

sources.title: Path of Exile 3.26.0 patch notes — Unpredictable Recombination
sources.notes: Unpredictable always succeeds. Fewer modifiers on average when inputs use many modifiers that cannot normally roll (Veiled, Essence). Corrupted items cannot be recombinated. Predictable lets you choose mods with a fail chance that destroys both items. Sentinel currencies deleted.

sources.title: PoE Wiki: Recombinator (Unpredictable overview + estimated count table)
sources.notes: Prefix/suffix pools independent. Estimated affix-count table. 50/50 base pick. 50/50 fill-order. Exclusive at most one. NNN ineligible on chosen base. Fractured cannot increase. Drop-only can transfer. Wiki flags the article as needing Predictable details.

sources.title: 3.25 recombination: rarer modifiers much higher chance to be selected
sources.notes: Exact selection-weight formula unpublished. Model uses inverse-sqrt spawn weight as an approximation.

sources.title: PoE Wiki: Recombinator costs Gold and Thaumaturgic Dust
sources.notes: Amount depends on item level and modifiers. No formula or table published.

sources.title: Maxroll Recombination Guide — empty 1-mod magics inflate dust
sources.notes: Slamming 1-mod (prefix-only or suffix-only) magics costs tens of thousands more dust than if you bench-craft any filler on the empty side.

sources.title: 3.27.0g Hotfix 2 — Idol recombination cost cut
sources.notes: Idol-only: −75% Thaumaturgic Dust and −50% Gold. Does not publish a general gear formula and does not apply to helmets/weapons/armour.

sources.title: Forum: one Unpredictable vs Predictable gold/dust readout
sources.notes: One player: Unpredictable 12k gold / 25k dust; Predictable 10k gold / 27k dust at 6.58% (magic weapons). Not a formula. Not an armour/helmet table.

cannotNormallyRollFewerMods.notes: GGG confirmed fewer mods on average; no official weights. Cannot-normally-roll affixes contribute countWeight toward the count table instead of 1. Old exclusive-mod padding is not modelled as beneficial.

selectionWeight.notes: 3.25 says rarer mods are more likely; exact formula unknown. Spawn-less specials use weight 1.

predictableSuccess.notes: Depends on amount and tier of chosen mods (GGG/wiki). Do not invent a table.

countDistribution.notes: Estimated Unpredictable table on wiki (community). Not Sentinel-era PoEDB numbers. Pool 0 → always 0 affixes.

cost.notes: PoE1 Unpredictable spends Gold + Thaumaturgic Dust. No GGG closed-form. Physical amounts = user empirical Unpredictable band midpoints (~25k Gold · ~85k Dust). Never invent 12+2n+0.04*ilvl; never 0. opportunityCostChaos ranks EV when daily prices lack gold/dust units.

averageUnpredictable.notes: Midpoints of anecdotal Unpredictable smash bands.

opportunityCostChaos.notes: Fallback unit chaos opportunity costs when daily.json has no gold/dust. Ranking only; display stays physical amounts.

emptyMagicInflatesDust.notes: 1-mod magics (empty opposite side) cost tens of thousands more dust; cheap bench filler on the empty side reduces it.

exclusiveModsIncreaseDust.notes: Essence / veiled / other cannot-normally-roll mods are reported to raise dust. No coefficient.

predictableVsUnpredictable.notes: Costs differ between modes; not the same number. No published mapping.

kingsmarchRank4.notes: Upgrade cost, not a smash formula. Unknown whether 3.29 hideout recombinator still applies this rank.

patchHistory.3.26: No published gold/dust formula. Fewer-mods rule for cannot-normally-roll (physics, not cost). Sentinel currencies deleted.
patchHistory.3.27.0g: Idol recombination only: −75% dust, −50% gold. Gear formula still unpublished.
patchHistory.3.29: No published gear gold/dust formula. User empirical Unpredictable band midpoints used as approximate amounts.

samples.notes: Primary physical amounts for display + EV until a published table exists. Data-driven — swap this entry when better measurements exist; do not hardcode midpoints in planner logic.
